title: [GMCP 203.046.05] Interoperability and quality: Property testing, fuzzing, model checking, and continuous red-team
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-046-05. Prove applicable official-suite and reference-SDK interoperability in both roles, direct-versus-gateway differential behavior, property invariants, transport and platform parity, and published latency, throughput, startup, memory, disk, and fairness budgets. Retain regression fixtures for every incompatibility found. Vector outcome: All parsers, serializers, state machines, URI/schema evaluators, policy decisions and transport boundaries have invariant/property tests and coverage-guided fuzz targets with retained regression seeds. Lifecycle, task and subscription models are checked for safety/liveness; threat-model abuse cases map to automated adversarial tests; sanitizer and red-team campaigns report zero unresolved critical/high findings at release. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
